title: 第十三章 诡异等级第十四章 幻梦级诡异
slug: 诡异复苏我以诡异打造世界
content_zh:
那些高等级的控梦师，之所以不愿意耗费时间处理那些低等级的梦魔，除了需要耗费时间之外。
也还有着那些梦魔，可不是被关押了就完事的。
所谓关押梦魔，不过就是以自己的精神梦境，将他们强行镇压，或是封锁在自己的精神梦境而已。
而他们每一次动用梦魔的诡异力量，那都相当于以自己的精神力量，主动去接触梦魔本体，借用梦魔的诡异力量。
这种情况下，那就相当于将自己的精神力量，一次次的主动融入梦魔，壮大梦魔的力量。
当梦魔的力量，壮大到一定程度之后，自然便会反噬控梦师，打破精神梦境。
到时候，不但控梦师会精神崩溃死亡，就连他们的精神灵魂，也会被梦魔所吞噬。
甚至就连他们的身体，都有可能被梦魔操控着继续害人。
本来，这个世界之上，已经很长时间，都没有梦魔投影降临，进而形成诡异了。
但是大概一年前的时候，又突然开始出现了诡异害人的情况。
在最一开始的时候，并没有引起国家层面的关注，只以为就是这些人，承受不住精神压力产生了幻觉而已。
但是随着这种事情越来越多，才终于是引起了国家层面的注意。
毕竟，世界各个大国，甚至一些大的家族，全都有着梦魔、诡异的记载，当这种事情频频出现的时候，自然便就引起了国家的注意。
于是，超凡梦境管理局成立了，开始控制这方面的信息。
虽然，国家也知道，一旦有诡异开始现世，那么便就代表着梦灵界的力量，再一次的达到了极限阈值，其与现实世界之间的屏障，即将再次打破。
并且这个过程，几乎是不可逆的，只会有着越来越多的梦魔降临，有着越来越多的诡异现世。
但是，那种情况能够晚一天到来，便能够少一些损失，少死一些人，也能做出更多的准备。
所以，各国才会不约而同的封锁这些消息，并且是能够封锁多久，便就封锁多久。
“也不知道我们什么时候才能成为驭诡者...”
在经过陆羽藏身单元楼的时候，其中的一个青年突然有些向往的说道。

“呵呵，我希望你们永远都不会成为驭诡者...”
听着手下队员的话，张威不由苦笑着说道。
“驭诡者，每天都是在生死边缘徘徊，一旦压制不住诡异，便会引起诡异反噬。
到时候，能够痛快的死，那都是一种幸福。
而且，每一次使用诡异的力量，那都相当于是在壮大诡异，加快诡异的挣脱复苏速度...”
在说到这里的时候，张威不由顿了顿，略微放轻了一些声音说道。
“也不知道，让你们两个这样的普通人，现在就接触这样的事情，对你们来说是好是坏...
本来，怎么也应该让你们了解一些情况的，只是没有想到，我才刚刚调到这里，便就发生了这样的事情。
也只能现在和你们说一些情况...
唉~！”
“呵呵，这是我们自己选择的，又和队长有什么关系？”
“是啊，队长！”
慢慢走到单元楼的门前，陆羽小心打量走过去的张威三人，同时心中暗中思忖。
「这就是官方针对这些梦魔的组织了吧。
只不过，怎么就这三人？
而且那个队长的实力，似乎也并不强，他的两个手下，更只是普通人。
「而且，这不应该是梦魔吗？他为什么说是诡异？
content_en:
The reason why those high-level dream control masters are unwilling to spend time dealing with those low-level dream demons is because it takes time.
There are also those dream demons, but they are not just imprisoned.
The so-called imprisoning dream demons is nothing more than using one's own mental dream to forcibly suppress them, or to seal them in one's own mental dream.
And every time they use the dream demon's strange power, it is equivalent to using their own spiritual power to actively contact the dream demon's body and borrow the dream demon's strange power.
In this case, it is equivalent to actively integrating one's own spiritual power into the dream demon again and again to strengthen the power of the dream demon.
When the power of the dream demon grows to a certain level, it will naturally backfire on the dream control master and break the mental dream.
At that time, not only will the dream controllers suffer mental breakdown and die, but even their spiritual souls will be swallowed up by the dream demon.
Even their bodies may be controlled by the dream demon to continue harming others.
Originally, there had been no nightmare projection in this world for a long time, which made it weird.
But about a year ago, strange and harmful things suddenly started to happen.
At the beginning, it did not attract national attention. It was just thought that these people could not bear the mental pressure and had hallucinations.
But as more and more of this happened, it finally attracted national attention.
After all, every big country in the world, and even some big families, all have records of nightmares and strange things. When such things happen frequently, they naturally attract the attention of the country.
As a result, the Transcendent Dream Management Bureau was established and began to control this information.
Although, the country also knows that once something weird starts to appear, it means that the power of the dream world has once again reached the extreme threshold, and the barrier between it and the real world is about to be broken again.
And this process is almost irreversible. More and more dream monsters will come, and more and more weird things will appear in the world.
However, if that situation can come one day later, there will be less losses, fewer people will die, and more preparations can be made.
Therefore, all countries will block this information in unison, and they will block it for as long as they can.
"I don't know when we will become the Tricksters..."
When passing by the unit building where Lu Yu was hiding, one of the young men suddenly said with some yearning.
"Haha, I hope you will never become the Trickster..."
After listening to the words of his team members, Zhang Wei couldn't help but smile bitterly.
"The controller of the weird is wandering on the edge of life and death every day. Once the weirdness cannot be suppressed, it will cause the weird backlash.
When the time comes, being able to die happily will be a blessing.
Moreover, every time Weird's power is used, it is equivalent to strengthening Weird and accelerating Weird's ability to break free and recover..."
When he said this, Zhang Wei couldn't help but paused and said in a slightly softer voice.
"I don't know if it is good or bad for you two to be exposed to such things now...
Originally, I should have let you know something about the situation, but I didn't expect that something like this would happen just after I was transferred here.
I can only tell you some things now...
Alas~! "
"Haha, this is our own choice, what does it have to do with the captain?"
"Yes, Captain!"
Slowly walking to the door of the unit building, Lu Yu carefully looked at Zhang Wei and the others who were walking by, while thinking secretly in his heart.
"This is the official organization targeting these dream demons.
But why are there only these three people?
And the captain didn't seem to be very strong, and his two men were just ordinary people.
"Besides, shouldn't this be a dream demon? Why did he say it was?Weird?
